story_overview: In his bedroom, Ryker is suddenly engulfed by an eerie green energy as a portal opens, revealing a menacing entity called The Shadow. His friends, including Leo and Finn, watch in horror as the supernatural events unfold. The group later gathers in an industrial workshop to understand the phenomenon, while Ryker is tormented by the mysterious power and the ever-present Shadow.

video_prompts:
Ryker: Man in a dark superhero suit with a white lightning bolt emblem.
The Bedroom: Bedroom interior featuring a wall with a pair of framed pictures and a bedroom lamp.
the ceramic table lamp: Bedroom table lamp with a round, glazed cream-colored ceramic base and a large, cylindrical drum shade made from textured, warm yellow-orange linen fabric.
the framed pictures: A pair of matching rectangular pictures in simple black wooden frames, each containing a blurry and indistinct image.

Ryker has a startled, wide-eyed expression as he looks around, alarmed. The entire scene is saturated in the eerie green energy. In the soft-focus background, the ceramic table lamp and the framed pictures are visible on the wall.

Leo: Man wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt.
Finn: Man with a slender build and fair skin, short dark unkempt hair, and a clean-shaven face, wearing a plain white crewneck t-shirt and light-colored pants.
the glowing portal: A rectangular doorway-shaped opening filled with an intense, glowing mixture of brilliant white and red light.

In the dark The Bedroom, saturated with the eerie green glow of the eerie green energy, Ryker's silhouette flickers within the intense light of the glowing portal. Nearby, Leo flinches slightly, staring in disbelief. From a close angle on Finn's face, his eyes widen with shock and confusion as he watches the event unfold.

The Shadow: A featureless figure with a pair of menacing, glowing red eyes.
The Phantom: Figure.

The dark room is filled with swirling eerie green energy as a brilliant green beam of light cuts horizontally across the scene. On the left, The Shadow stands silhouetted inside the glowing light of the glowing portal, its red eyes pulsing slowly. On the right, Leo trembles slightly in silhouette as the green beam emanates from his body, while The Phantom drifts slowly beside him.

Caleb: Young man with short curly hair, wearing a white V-neck T-shirt and a long beaded necklace with a red tassel.

Extreme close-up from a low angle of the horror figurines arranged on the reflective surface.
